system.description:
You delay the death of a friend, by any means necessary. When a creature within 5 feet of you falls to 0 hit points you strike a series of pressure points in a desperate attempt to save them, if only for a moment. The target remains at 0 hit points, but stays conscious until the end of their next turn. If the creature would end their turn with 0 hit points after this jutsu’s casting, they fall unconscious.

Regardless if they regain hit points or fall unconscious, they gain 1 failed death saving throws.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank, the creatures instead fails 0 death saving throws. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, the creature remains at 1 Hit point.
